help.cascade.title: Cascade reward
help.cascade.body: Three matching cascades after the initial action grant one bonus Pulse (3×3). At most one per move, placed after the cascades finish. Tap it to fire for one move. Tools do not grant this bonus.
help.pulse.title: Pulse blast
help.pulse.body: Match 4 in a line or 5 in a T/L to create Pulse (3×3 blast, breaks covers). Tap to fire: 1 move. Drag to swap only if the other tile makes a match: 1 move, no blast. Chained blasts are free.
help.nova.title: Nova blast
help.nova.body: Match 5 or more in a line to create Nova (row + column, breaks covers). Tap to fire: 1 move. Drag to swap only if the other tile makes a match: 1 move, no blast. Chained blasts are free.
help.laser.title: Laser
help.laser.body: Laser hits one selected tile. A protective cover breaks first; the tile beneath stays. It uses one tool from your stock, not a move.
help.shuffle.title: Shuffle
help.shuffle.body: Shuffle rearranges uncovered tiles to offer new matches. It uses one tool from your stock, not a move.
help.swap.title: Swap
help.swap.body: Swap exchanges two adjacent uncovered tiles even without a match. It uses one tool from your stock, not a move.
help.beam.title: Beam
help.beam.body: Beam hits the entire selected row and can trigger charges. It uses one tool from your stock, not a move.
help.emp.title: EMP
help.emp.body: EMP hits a 3×3 area around the selected tile and can trigger charges. It uses one tool from your stock, not a move.
help.charges.title: Pulse & Nova
help.charges.body: 4 in a line or 5 in a T/L: Pulse (3×3). 5+ in a line: Nova (row + column). Tap to fire: 1 move. Drag to swap only if the other tile makes a match: 1 move, no blast. Chain reactions are free.
help.covers.title: Protective covers
help.covers.body: The tile beneath a cover is visible. Include it in a match of the same type to break the cover. That tile stays on the board for another match. Covered tiles cannot be swapped; blasts can also break covers.
help.resonators.title: Charge the resonator
help.resonators.body: Match 3 so a matched tile touches the ring above, below, left or right. Each separate match adds +1 per ring, even in the same wave. Diagonals and direct blasts do not charge it. Charge every ring to its target.
help.helpers.title: Your tools
help.helpers.body: Select a tool below the board, then its target. Shuffle acts immediately. Each use spends one tool, not a move. Stock is shared across levels. AD offers an ad to refill an empty tool. Choose a tool in Help topics to learn its effect.
help.selectAgain: Select the tool again after closing this tip. Nothing is spent now.
help.chargeShapes: Match identical tiles in one of these shapes to create a charge.
help.chargeUse: Tap to fire: 1 move. Swap only if the other tile makes a match: 1 move, no blast.
help.chain: Blasts also break covers. Any charges hit explode for free.
